title: Ying-Yang
description: A minecraft Mod With Weaponry Custom Auras And Dissapearance..
body:
**_PLEASE DONT USE TO LAG SERVERS_**


dissapearance: its a display item for aesthetic purposes. DOES ABSOLOTELY NOTHING image

absolute_altercation: a big ass sword 7 atk damage and 1 atk speed. right click lose some hp but get lvls :D 

Charm Summoner: a shovel has a hidden way to summon charms that only the charm owner and mod devs know about 
confused ingot: an ore used to craft stuff in this mod :D made with a half confused ingot. a gold ingot a iron ingot and a netherite scrap :) 

half confused ingot: obtained by smelting a diamond. and also used to craft the charm summoner 

steel greatsword: another big ass sword just a normal sword that does 10 atk dmg and 1.6 atk speed 

magik aura: obtained by the charm summoner 

(t's charm): Tyler_s_121's charm (his aura): adds a red aura obtained also by the charm summoner 

v8ybyv8b's charm: another aura obtained also by the charm summoner 

ultimatebb8's charm: another aura obtained also by the charm summoner


sickle: a weapon that shoots out your own blood 

Tyler's Special Axe: just an ordinary axe as i wanted custom :D
